betaDescription: Salini — нативное приложение: каталог, подбор изделий, сравнение материалов на официальных 3D-моделях, проекты и персональные предложения PDF. Режимы покупателя, дизайнера и партнёра, библиотека документов, салоны на карте и помощь. Salini Inside — интерактивная демонстрация производства. Проекты сохраняются на устройстве. Производственные данные, остатки, резервы и отгрузки демонстрационные; реальные заказы не отправляются.
whatToTest: Новое в 1.0 (7): обновлён свет и поверхности в студии материалов. Сравните S-Stone и S-Sense на белом, зелёном RAL 6005 и антрацитовом RAL 7016; откройте крупный план, смените форму и направление света. Проверяйте отражения глянца, мягкость матовой поверхности и тень под изделием. Цвета остаются экранным приближением. PDF сохраняет прежний печатный свет. Коллекционные видео в этой сборке не заменены; новые окружения пока исследовательские исходники.
reviewNotes: Build 1.0 (7) improves native material rendering with a bundled CC0 studio HDRI, finish-specific microstructure, a Gelcoat layer, softer contact/cast shadows, and Khronos PBR Neutral tone mapping. Third-party notices ship in the bundle. Color is an approximate visualization, not a calibrated proof. PDF rendering intentionally keeps its previous lighting. No new data collection, sign-in, or network rendering service. Existing collection films are unchanged. Build 1.0 (6) refines the Inside business board with live stage status, semantic colors, compact metrics and read-only model-driven order stages. No analytics or new data collection. No sign-in is required. Build 1.0 (5) adds an action-focused Salini Inside entry, a swipeable business board and camera tracking of simulated orders and trucks. Pan/zoom enters manual exploration; Return to event follows the current stage of the same order. Build 4 added an offline catalog of 305 product cards and 539 material/finish variants, 13 official Salini 3D models, a material comparison studio, local multi-project storage, and personalized PDF proposals. Proposals contain selected product facts, specifications and color studies; no payment or real order submission occurs. Profile opens a showroom map and FAQ. Designer mode adds a document library. Profile > Salini Inside opens a simulated factory with ten areas in two complexes, fixed isometric navigation and linked order scenarios. All factory orders, stock, reservations, staff and shipping data are simulated; actions do not operate real equipment. Catalog prices, availability and showroom data are a dated public-site snapshot, not live inventory. RAL colors are approximate and customized pricing is by request. Product photos and models originate from salini-srl.com. Four bundled silent artistic collection films play an introduction followed by ambient loops; Reduce Motion uses a still. Projects and preferences remain on the device. External product document links and maps require internet. No purchases, advertising or third-party analytics SDKs. Requires iOS/iPadOS 27 or later.
